page.layout: One printed title page, centred. Title lines at the top, a framed woodcut engraving in the middle, imprint lines at the bottom. The scan is upside down. No running head, page number or margin notes.
page.notes: The scan is rotated 180 degrees; the text is printed upside down and was read after turning the image. Below the title lines is a framed woodcut engraving, faint and partly obscured by show-through and staining. It shows figures and a scene with architectural detail, and cannot be transcribed as text. The line "E parte primâ HISTORICÂ PACIS" is hard to read; the final word may be FACIS or PACIS, marked [?]. The printer's line "Apud Vidvam, & Ioannem Moretum" and the privilege line at the foot are only partly legible, so they are marked [?]. Dark stains and marks on the left side of the page are not printed text.
